note: Two gravel pull-ins in the Callen Run Tract, each at the end of a drive of about 350 ft, with a picnic table and fire ring, under tree canopy. Fire Tower is on Fire Tower Road about 2.2 miles in; the agency calls it suitable for group camping and room for two campers. McNeil Station is 0.6 mile down McNeil Station Road, which leaves Fire Tower Road at 1.6 miles. From PA 28 the way in is Egypt Road, Richardsville Road and Fire Tower Road, a forest road. The agency warns that four-wheel drive or tire chains may be needed in winter conditions. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
